name: Roaring Beam / resolution lifecycle / empty-soul-return-and-charge-other
notes: The empty-soul condition is checked after creating Courage. Return Roaring Beam from the resolving Stack to its owner hand before prompting charge, then charge raging_onslaught_yellow. The already moved source must not be cleared again by the reaction finalizer. Generic attack4, health20, no resources spent, AP0 remain. Charging Roaring Beam itself is legal because it has returned to hand before charge.
